They design, develop, and manufacture music-making devices.

aiResearchSummary.text: ROLI is focused on enhancing touch-sensitive user interfaces for music technology applications. Their research includes a force sensor system that involves a substrate with resilient protrusions, enabling precise input force measurement. This innovation aims to improve the tactile response and sensitivity of musical devices, potentially offering musicians a more nuanced and expressive way to interact with hardware and software instruments.
